title: Israeli warplanes strike mountainous eastern Lebanon; drone and artillery fire hits southern towns
detail: Lebanese state media reported five Israeli airstrikes on a mountainous area in eastern Lebanon on Thursday, alongside further airstrikes, drone attacks and artillery shelling on several towns in the south. Casualty details were not confirmed in available reports.

sources.name: Middle East Monitor (citing Lebanese state media)

media.caption: Israeli airstrikes hit eastern Lebanon, target homes, buildings in south
